name: squiggle-arrow
title: Squiggle Arrow
blurb: SVG arrow with wavy, bouncy, or smooth paths, pointing in any direction.
description: An SVG arrow component with three pattern variants (wavy, bouncy, smooth) and four directional rotations, using currentColor for theming.
use_when: Decorative directional indicators in tutorials, guides, or call-to-action visuals.
avoid_when: For navigation arrows — use chevron or arrow icon components instead.
a11y: SVG with descriptive title but presentational content; not semantic.
